blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – The Negros First CyberCentre here is following into the footsteps of an increasing number of establishments in the country seeking green options as it officially transitions to clean energy following the successful installation of 949 solar panels at the facility. Provincial Administrator Rayfrando Diaz announced Friday, Nov. 6, that the project was completed in partnership with private energy developer Wegen, marking another milestone in the provincial government’s shift toward sustainable power. “The provincial government is continuing to transition to clean and sustainable energy for all its facilities.
